name: [UPDATE - Sect & Trade] Soul Cultivation
desc:
✧  Soul Cultivation is a non-linear cultivation game inspired by ancient Chinese mythology, known as Xianxia

✧ PRIVATE SERVERS ARE FREE!

✧ uh.. chests?

➤   Explore different zones, harvest rare herbs, defeat powerful enemies, discover hidden treasures, and grow stronger at your own pace. There is no fixed path, your progression depends on your choices and effort.
➤   Reach 100 Harvesting to unlock your first Soul Servant. Talk to Zhang Yiwang near the docks for a quest that makes it easier. Unlocking your first servant greatly speeds up progression since crafting pills becomes much easier!

⮦    CONTROLS    ⮧                            
  ⬧ C - Cultivate
  ⬧ T - Train
  ⬧ B -  Breakthrough

  ⬨ F to Block
  ⬨ Q - Dash (while Sprinting)
  ⬨ Left Shift - Sprint (Toggle)
  ⬨ Left Ctrl - Shift Lock

➤ Auto rejoin every 19 minutes if AFK
➤ Altars spawn every 30 minutes
➤ Treasures respawn 3x slower in private servers
➤ Join the group for 1.05x more Qi

✧  Ask Questions in the Community!
